draft.emotion: warm and sincere, reflecting a deep personal connection
notes: Takes either से (se) or को (ko) with the person loved: मैं तुमसे प्यार करता हूँ (I love you).
Used for people (family, partners) or pets. To say you 'love' an object, food, or activity, use बहुत पसंद होना instead.

draftBefore.shortGloss: to love; to like very much
draftBefore.emotion: warm and sincere, reflecting a deep personal connection
notes: Use the postposition 'se' (से) to indicate who you love: 'Main tumse pyaar karta hoon' (I love you).

While it can mean to like someone very much, it is a strong expression, often reserved for family, close friends, or romantic partners. For simple liking of things or casual acquaintances, use 'pasand karna' instead.
